$comment: CANONICAL IQAMA RESOLUTION FIXTURE — the single source of truth for a rule that is
They have already drifted twice. In June 2026 iOS and Android ignored time_ranges
entirely, so fixed iqama times never displayed. In July 2026 the tvOS board still did,
showing iqama == adhan while the phone showed the correct time — the two products
visibly disagreed in the same lobby. Separately, the website served the previous
range's Fajr time for a whole day after a range boundary.
Every implementation asserts against THIS file. Copy it verbatim into each repo; the
copies are checked byte-for-byte by a checksum test so they cannot silently diverge.
For each prayer, if iqama_type == 'specific_time_ranges' AND a range for that prayer
covers today (start_date <= today <= end_date, BOTH INCLUSIVE, compared in the
masjid's timezone), the iqama is that range's specific_time. Otherwise the iqama is
adhan + the per-prayer offset in minutes. The two mechanisms coexist: Burlington uses
fixed times for fajr/dhuhr/asr and offsets for maghrib/isha, simultaneously.

cases.name: mid-range: fixed times win for fajr/dhuhr/asr, offsets still apply to maghrib/isha
last day of a sub-range — end_date is INCLUSIVE
first day of the next sub-range — start_date is INCLUSIVE. This is the exact boundary the website got wrong on 2026-07-26, serving 05:20 while every app served 05:25.
first day of the month, earliest fajr sub-range
last day of the month — still inside the dhuhr/asr whole-month range
NO range covers this date — every prayer falls back to adhan + offset. Offsets of 0 mean iqama == adhan, which is what the tvOS board wrongly showed for ALL dates before the July 2026 fix.
a date before every range — same fallback, guarding against an off-by-one that treats 'no match' as 'first range'
June: fajr has a whole-month range but dhuhr/asr do not, so the two mechanisms mix WITHIN one day
offset arithmetic crosses an hour boundary

offsets_only_settings.$comment: A masjid that uses NO fixed times at all — iqama_type is minutes_after_adhan and there are no ranges. Guards against an implementation that assumes time_ranges is always present.

ignored_ranges_settings.$comment: Ranges EXIST but iqama_type is minutes_after_adhan, so they must be ignored entirely. An implementation that resolves ranges without first checking iqama_type fails here.

ignored_ranges_cases.name: iqama_type wins over the presence of ranges
